Mapping of account address to token balance.

SafeMath addition helper performing a + b with an overflow check.

SafeMath division helper performing a / b with a require(b > 0) guard.

onlyOwner-gated function starting two-step ownership transfer by writing newOwner.

Returns the balance stored for a given tokenOwner.
Moves tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using safeSub/safeAdd.
Sets the allowance for spender from msg.sender.
Spends allowance and moves tokens from/from-to using safeSub/safeAdd.
Returns the remaining allowance of spender for tokenOwner.
Sets allowance then invokes receiveApproval on the spender contract (external callback).
Payable fallback that always reverts, refusing ETH.
onlyOwner function that performs an external call to an arbitrary token contract transferring tokens to owner.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization and balance/allowance indexing.
Raw _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] subtraction bypassing SafeMath; reverts/underflows if the burn balance exceeds supply.
External call to ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval with attacker-controlled target and calldata.
External call to an arbitrary, owner-supplied token contract via ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer.
Addition a + b evaluated before the overflow require in safeAdd.
Subtraction a - b in safeSub guarded only by require(b <= a).
Multiplication a * b in safeMul followed by an overflow check.
Division a / b in safeDiv guarded by require(b > 0).
require(msg.sender == owner) access-control check enforced by the onlyOwner modifier.
require(msg.sender == newOwner) access-control check in acceptOwnership.

edges.reason: transfer reads msg.sender to debit the caller balance.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is spent.
approveAndCall uses msg.sender as allowance owner and callback sender argument.
acceptOwnership authorization depends entirely on msg.sender == newOwner.
transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender with owner.
Owned constructor derives the privileged owner directly from msg.sender.
transferAnyERC20Token is onlyOwner gated, so msg.sender controls the privileged external call.
msg.sender is used as the balances mapping index in transfer/transferFrom paths.
msg.sender is used as the outer allowed mapping key.
Owned constructor writes the owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership reassigns the privileged owner state variable.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner back to address(0).
KBS constructor sets symbol.
KBS constructor sets name.
KBS constructor sets decimals.
KBS constructor sets _totalSupply.
KBS constructor mints the whole supply into balances.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply performs an unchecked subtraction instead of calling safeSub.
The unchecked subtraction consumes the _totalSupply state variable.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient.
transfer mutates the balances mapping.
transferFrom calls safeSub for the balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
approveAndCall executes an external contract callback after updating allowance.
The user-supplied spender address is the target of the external receiveApproval callback.
The external callee may re-enter the KBS contract (e.g. transfer/transferFrom) during receiveApproval.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an arbitrary token contract.
The external token contract may re-enter the privileged transferAnyERC20Token flow.
The recovered tokens are sent to the privileged owner address under onlyOwner.
safeAdd evaluates the raw addition a + b.
safeSub evaluates the raw subtraction a - b.
safeMul evaluates the raw multiplication a * b.
safeDiv evaluates the raw division a / b.
transferOwnership depends on the onlyOwner require(msg.sender == owner) check.
acceptOwnership depends on require(msg.sender == newOwner).
